title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of Nb25Mo25Ta25W25 and Ti8Nb23Mo23Ta23W23 high entropy alloys prepared by mechanical alloying and spark plasma sintering
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying for 60 hours with ball-to-powder weight ratio of 15:1 at 400 rpm, followed by spark plasma sintering at 1873 K for 8 min with 35 MPa pressure
